extracts.lead_summary: The engine coughed and there was nothing behind it. META gave back 3.1% — a 4.8% drop on Monday alone, on profit-taking after a +30% September, a report that OpenAI is building an always-on assistant, and a Goldman note on what AI capex has to earn — and with the fund's largest weight down, the other half's lows counted again. Netflix fell 5.7% to a new 52-week low at $67.06. Comcast and Charter made new lows for a fourth week. AT&T lost 4.3%. XLC closed $110.32 (-2.3%), back under the 50-day it reclaimed a week ago and through $110 on Thursday's close. The repair lasted one week. Last week I called the barbell balanced; it was one stock holding up the bar.
